authority.scope: GTK2 Theme Lab only; native scene interaction checks in private Xvfb; no user-session installation.

environment.input: xdotool only to the private Xvfb; no desktop or MAME input

results.pointer_cases: 6/6 value changes; both scale orientations and spin in coupled and detached origins
results.entry_native_editing: 24 scenes passed across four schemes; all required keyboard/clipboard/undo/redo assertions passed

controls.combo: Popup/item selection, wheel changes active item, End key, selection/drag; coupled and detached.
controls.scale_h: Native pointer click changes value 38 to 48; coupled and detached.
controls.scale_v: Native pointer click changes value 62 to 52; coupled and detached.
controls.list: Keyboard selection plus horizontal/vertical scrolling with 40 long rows; coupled and detached.
controls.entry: GTK2 keyboard editing in four schemes; UTF-8, select-all, replacement, copy/paste/cut, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y and Ctrl+Shift+Z.
controls.text: GTK2 TextView keyboard and clipboard editing with Undo/Redo in coupled and detached scenes.
controls.spin: Native pointer click on increment arrow changes value 42 to 43; coupled and detached.

diagnostic_attempts.note: Initial private probe failed due to fixture directory permissions and incorrect VScale requested geometry/coordinates; those issues were corrected in the temporary fixture. No product change was made.

limits: The visual appearance of all these controls has not been approved against Domain/OS; native interaction success is not historical fidelity.
Historical held-state capture for left/right/up scrollbar arrows remains open because the canonical VM display is black.
No product code, user session, XChat instance, palette or VM state was changed.
The C controller does not persist transient GTK2 sample values as recipe edits; R303 does not claim end-to-end project persistence for native sample interactions.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: All 16 controls have public metrics and coupled/detached controller mounting; R303 adds directed GTK2 native input behavior for the seven actionable controls. Remaining C-controller event propagation, historical pressed states and human visual review are open. This is technical coverage, not visual fidelity.

controller_boundary.basis: Native preview values/text/selection are temporary widget state, not theme-recipe edits. In controller.c, TL_EVENT_NATIVE is mirrored only for toggle/check and radio state display; generic sample values do not commit project changes. R303 validates native GTK2 scene behavior, not project persistence of sample interaction.
